items.title: Extending the Context Length to 1M Tokens!
items.summary: API Documentation (Chinese) HuggingFace Demo ModelScope Demo Introduction After the release of Qwen2.5, we heard the community’s demand for processing longer contexts. In recent months, we have made many optimizations for the model capabilities and inference performance of extremely long context. items.summaryZh: 通义千问正式推出Qwen2.5-Turbo，响应社区对超长上下文处理的需求。该版本将模型的上下文窗口从128k大幅扩展至100万Token（约合100万英文单词），并通过多项系统级优化保持了长文本处理的性能与效率。
